policy_class: Qwen semantic planner + RGB tools + numerical pose skills

model_requests.instruction:
Task: Pick the ladle from the counter and place it in the drawer.
Identify the movable source object to pick up and return its name in target. Images are ordered left camera, right camera, wrist camera. For each view, describe its appearance and give its visible center. All points must refer to that same source object. If it is not visible, set visible false and point_2d null. Use relative coordinates 0 through 1000 on each image; top-left [0,0], bottom-right [1000,1000].

left.description: A black ladle with a round bowl and a long handle, lying flat on the wooden countertop to the left of the sink.

right.description: The ladle is not visible in this view.

wrist.description: A black ladle with a round bowl and a long handle, lying on the wooden countertop.

model_requests.instruction: Inspect the current three RGB views. Is the target ladle held between the gripper fingers and lifted clear of the surface? Measured finger separation is 0.010426889639347792 metres; the close action was executed, followed by a 15cm lift. Describe object evidence in the images.

response.description: The black ladle is grasped by the robot's gripper and lifted above the wooden table surface. In the first view, the ladle is held vertically with its handle in the gripper. The second view shows the ladle positioned over the sink area, clearly elevated from the table. The third view provides a close-up of the gripper holding the handle of the ladle.

model_requests.instruction: Task: place the held object inside the open drawer. All three images show the SAME wrist camera observation. The left image slot is the original scene. The right image slot shows numbered binary masks, with white pixels marking each candidate in original image coordinates. The wrist slot shows original-color crops from the same mask bounding boxes, with the same IDs. Select the mask covering the interior floor of the open drawer, the receiving surface on which the object can be placed. Distinguish that floor from the countertop, sink, drawer front, and robot gripper. Return null if no candidate covers the receiving floor. Describe the selected region.

response.description: The large, flat wooden surface occupying the right side of the scene, which serves as the open drawer's interior floor.
